sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Arrived at office and doing debrief with night shift before heading out on patrol.
All geared up and heading out on patrol towards Aotea Square. (Will be conducting welfare checks on businesses during patrol towards check-in areas.)
Welfare check on Starbucks, Localito, Queen St McDonald's and 77 Convenience Store, all clear. All stores checked have just opened. Continuing towards Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square and commencing a sweep of the area.
Area is all clear, standing by for security presence.
Library area is all clear. Heading up Wellesley St towards Federal St.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria and Federal St. Welfare checks completed on Eighty Fed, both 77 Convenience Store, Coffee Club and News Agency store. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Darby via Elliot and Victoria St.
Elliot and Darby St all clear, heading towards Lorne St via Wellesley St.
Sweep of Lorne St all clear. Heading towards High St.
Sweep of High St, Freyberg Square, Vulcan Lane all clear. Heading towards Chancery Square via O'Connell St.
Arrived and completed a sweep of Chancery Square, all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Fort St via Shortland St and High St.
Fort St, Fort Lane, Pocket Park, Wilson Carpark, Jo&Joes, Right Track and Coffee Club all clear, no issues to report. Heading towards Gore St.
Gore St including Auckland Harbour Suites all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Arrived Britomart McDonald's and completed welfare check on 77 Convenience Store and Custom Mart. All clear, same for Britomart McDonald's. Heading to check on TK Square and Commercial Bay.
TK Square and Commercial Bay all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading to check on Lower Albert Woolworths and Aotea Gifts.
All clear from both locations. Heading up Albert St.
Welfare check on Albert Mart. All clear.
Arrived and completed a welfare check on the Cathedral. Area all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Coffee Club Custom St due to a call regarding yelling and a vagrant getting naked across the road at the Kiwibank.

We arrived and the manager who called had left to pick up an order; the worker stated the two across the road were disrupting business which is why they closed the outside. We spoke to one of them and he denied the allegations. Standing by for security presence. (video on file)
Heading towards Queen St via Custom St.
Welfare check on Q Convenience Store, all clear. Continuing patrol up Queen St.
Welfare check on businesses from Quest on Queen St till Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues to report. Standing by at Vulcan Lane for security presence.
Welfare check on JB Hi-Fi, Kathmandu, Macpac, Mountain Warehouse, Hallensteins, Specsavers, OPSM and Chemist Warehouse. No issues to report. Standing by for security presence.
Welfare checks on Oscar Wylee, Kiwiana, Pagani, Mirrou, Skechers, Platypus, Typo, TechPro, Lovisa, Dunkin Donuts and Merri & Gifts. No issues to report. Checking in on Durham St.
Durham St all clear. Welfare check on BBQ Kings and Mid Town Minimart. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards the corner of Victoria and Queen St.

Welfare checks on Glassons, 2degrees, Lush, Peter Alexander, Noel Leeming, Dangerfield, Uggs, Mecca, Vans, W Cosmetics and Farmers, all clear. No issues to report. Heading up to check on Woolworths Victoria St.
Woolworths, Chemist Warehouse and Real Groovy all clear. Security complained about vagrants begging outside store. Standing by for security presence.
Heading to do final check around the area before break.
Elliot and Darby St all clear. Continuing patrol.
Welfare check from Acceco Supermarket, NZ Muscle down till Starbucks. All businesses all clear, no issues to report. Having break at HQ.
Responded to call from Vans due to them asking for assistance with an individual acting suspicious in store.
Arrived on site, was asked to trespass the individual by the assistant manager; we managed to speak to the individual and gave him a trespass, he understood the terms, no further issues.
Standing by at the office for shift changeover.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Standing by in office charging ops phone (7%) awaiting response calls.
Welfare check on Elliott Street, standing by showing presence.
Elliott Stables all clear, no further issues, continuing patrol.
Continuing patrol down Queen Street towards Wyndham Street.
Arrived at Wyndham Street, welfare check on stores, standing by showing presence.
All clear, no further issues, continuing patrol towards Albert Street.
Arrived at Commercial Bay, welfare check on businesses, commencing patrol around the area awaiting response calls.
All clear, no further issues, area secured. Patrolling down Quay Street, welfare check-in on stores.
Currently still here on Quay Street.
Commencing patrol towards HQ, Ops phone on 3%.
Arrived at HQ charging ops phone while waiting for response calls.
Ops phone charged at 56%, commencing patrol towards Aotea Square.
Arriving at Aotea Square, standing by showing presence waiting for response calls.
Full sweep all clear, no further issues. Commencing patrol down Queen Street.
Welfare check on Queen Street Maccas, standing by showing presence.
Welfare check on Woolworths Victoria Street, all clear, no issues.
Arriving at Fort Street sweeping the area, all clear, no issues.
Continuing patrol down Fort Lane towards Commercial Bay.
Arrived at Commercial Bay, welfare check on Britomart Maccas, standing by.
Full sweep all clear, no further issues. Commencing patrol on Quay Street.
Received response call from Queen Street Maccas regarding a female shouting and disrupting the public, also sleeping inside.
Arrived at location, female was still inside sleeping, was asked to vacate the building, she complied. Standing by showing presence in case she returns.
Heading to HQ to do floor checks.
Floor checks all clear, standing by HQ to charge Ops phone (12%).
Commencing patrol heading towards High Street.
Partial completion all clear, no issues. Continuing to Chancery via Freyberg Square.
Freyberg Square sweep complete, no issues to report, no response calls to report, no further issues. Heading to Chancery.
Received a call for Japan Dollar Mart Queen Street, possible break-in to store.
Arrived at location, possibility of a break-in, commencing a full sweep of the area making sure no one is inside.
Full sweep all clear, no one in sight, standing by to show presence making sure the area is secured.
Wyndham Street welfare check on stores still open, all clear, no issues. Heading back to office for 30 minute break.
Our 30 minute break completed, patrolling around the area until guard handover.
Arrived on Darby Street commencing sweep.
Full sweep, welfare checks on stores Pizza Club, Celines, Thai Food, all clear.
Welfare check Elliot carpark, Dominoes Pizza, The Fresh Market, Indian buffet, all clear, no issues. Patrolling up to Elliot Stables.
Arrived at Elliot Stables commencing welfare checks maintaining presence.
Full sweep Elliot Stables, Elliot Street, all clear. Heading back to office to standby outside for guard handover.
Welfare check Mid City, all clear.
Welfare check Avachi Chicken, Mcdonalds Queens, Timezone, 77 Convenience Store, all clear. Heading back to headquarters.
Arrived at headquarters standing by outside till guard handover.
Afternoon shift concluded, handing over to Night shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Suited up commencing patrols. Heading down Queen Street.
Durham Street East appears to have no activity.
Arrived at Wyndham Street East intersection. Low foot traffic thus far. No cause for concern in the area.
Vulcan Lane less busy than usual. Stores should be closing soon. Behaviour in the area is satisfactory.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Carrying out sweep in the area.
Commercial Bay all clear. Medium foot traffic in the area. Welfare check on Britomart McDonald's. Standing by shortly to show presence and await potential response calls.
Britomart McDonald's all clear. No cause for concern in the area at this point in time. Continuing patrols.
Full sweep Quay St all clear, no issues, welfare checks conducted at AAS / Providor, no issues to report. Heading up Albert St.
Welfare check Albert St Convenience Store, no issues.
Full sweep Albert St / Mayoral Drive all clear, no issues.
Patrolling Aotea Square commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete, all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check Queen St Maccas, no issues to report.
Full sweep High St / Freyberg / Chancery Square / Kitchener St all clear, no issues. Heading back to HQ charging ops phone.
Heading out on patrols, phone on 25%. Heading up Victoria St.
Check-in St Patrick's Cathedral Church, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Wyndham St all clear, no issues to report.
Check-in Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Fort St / Wilson Carpark all clear, no issues.
Check-in Gore St, all clear, no issues.
Check-in Britomart Maccas / Commercial Bay, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Quay St all clear, no issues. Heading back up Queen St.
Queen St all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep Wellesley Street all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Elliot St / Darby St / Wilson Carpark all clear, no issues. Heading to HQ for 30 minutes break.
Check-in Queen St Maccas, no issues.
Check-in Aotea Square, all clear, no issues.
Check-in corner of Lorne St / Wakefield, no issues.
Full sweep Lorne St / Victoria St all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Albert St all clear, no issues.
Check-in Britomart Maccas / Commercial Bay, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Queen St all clear, no issues. Heading back to HQ to charge ops phone.
On standby at HQ awaiting changeover.
